_about: Hard-coded reference data for the Lucerna Weekly production pipeline. Extracted verbatim from shipped editions (files/weekly-report-*/WEEKLY-KIT.md + shipped SVG badge/footer strings) and cross-checked against the weekly repo frontmatter (~/workspace/weekly-git/issues/2026-w43/). Do NOT invent strings here: change this file only from a shipped artifact, and note the source.

_sources.furniture: Shipped SVG P1 badge + P2 footer strings (authoritative render) and the establishing KITs: FRxIT (IT column), ENxPT (PT column), FRxDE (DE column), ENxFR/DE xFR (FR column), FRxES/ENxES (ES column), ENxNL/FRxNL builds (NL column, provisional).
_sources.threads: Repo frontmatter discordThread per target (72 editions, one unique value per target, verified 2026-10-21) — matches the task brief exactly.

columns._note: One entry per reader-native (explanation) language. badge_template/footer_template use placeholders {MASTHEAD} {VOL} {T_BADGE} {T_FADJ} {T_FNOUN} {N}. Per-target name forms live in target_names: T_BADGE = the exact target-name segment inside the badge (for DE it includes the word TEXT, e.g. 'FRANZÖSISCHER TEXT'; for zh in DE it is 'CHINESISCHER TEXT (VEREINFACHT)'), T_FADJ = adjective before WOCHENZEITUNG/HEBDOMADAIRE/etc., T_FNOUN = noun after TEXT AUF / TEXTE EN / TESTI IN / TEXTOS EM / TEKSTEN IN. Forms marked derived=true have no shipped example yet and were formed by the column's own grammar pattern — verify against the first shipped edition that uses them.

de.badge_template: {T_BADGE} · DEUTSCHE ERKLÄRUNGEN — DIE AUSGABE FÜR DEUTSCHSPRACHIGE LESER
de.footer_template: {MASTHEAD} · {T_FADJ} WOCHENZEITUNG VOL.{VOL} · TEXT AUF {T_FNOUN} · ERKLÄRUNGEN AUF DEUTSCH

variants: Badge singular/plural split in shipped editions: 'TEXTE EN …' for EN, DE, RU, JA, KO targets; 'TEXTES EN …' for IT, NL, PT, ES, ZH targets. Footer always uses singular 'TEXTE EN'.
EN×FR KIT once records gloss prefix 'Note | ' — the shipped gloss boxes across the column use 'Note — ' (IT×FR, NL×FR KITs); treat 'Note | ' as an early-edition variant, not the pattern.
P1 edition line often needs the JOURNAL short variant at smaller size when HEBDOMADAIRE overflows (DE×FR, IT×FR, NL×FR precedents) — edition line only, footers keep HEBDOMADAIRE.

edition_dir_rule._note: files/ directory names. Fan-outs: weekly-report-<target>-<native>. Cores are the languages' core_dir values (note the irregular ones: fr -> weekly-report-vol4, zh-cn -> weekly-report-zhcn-vol1, zh-tw -> weekly-report-zhtw-vol1). Two shipped exceptions pin-verified in the P8 audit: zh-cn-fr -> weekly-report-zhcn-fr (NOT the hyphenated pre-fix dir weekly-report-zh-cn-fr), zh-tw-fr -> weekly-report-zh-tw-fr.

fonts._note: Actual files on this VM are the split Regular/Bold TTCs (there is no combined NotoSerifCJK.ttc). Face indices inside every TTC: JP=0, KR=1, SC=2, TC=3, HK=4 — identical to the audit doc convention (JP=0/KR=1/SC=2/TC=3). The builds discover the index by face name (svglib._sc_index per build locale); the tools do the same by family suffix.

frontmatter._source: ~/workspace/weekly-git/lint.mjs (REQUIRED_FM, LANGS, SLUG_RE, WEEK_RE, DATE_RE, SHA_RE) + README.md + AGENTS.md
frontmatter.index_rule: index.json is generated by `node lint.mjs --write` only — never hand-edit; `node lint.mjs --require-pdf` is the strict pre-publish gate
pairing_rules: zh-cn x zh-tw pairings do not exist in either direction
frontmatter.pdf_rule: pdfBytes/pdfSha256 are measured from the FINAL web PDF; the in-repo PDF must match both byte-for-byte; print PDFs never enter the repo
frontmatter.slug_rule: <week lowercase>-<target>-<native>, e.g. 2026-w43-fr-zh-cn; slug must equal the value derived from frontmatter week/target/native
frontmatter.week_dir_rule: issues/<week lowercase>/ is its own level (YYYY-wNN); edition dirs only inside their own week dir
